title: A worker moves its branch after git packs refs, and unsubmitted commits survive
description: In a repository whose graphyard/* refs are packed and whose refs/heads/graphyard directory is absent, a confined worker commits on its assigned branch and completes even after a later pack; a head detached at a descendant of the branch completes and moves the branch; a closed attempt's commits on no branch stay reachable from refs/graphyard/preserved/<key>-<attempt>, which the next attempt's prompt names.

steps.name: packed refs, detached head and preserved commits
